# 1 Chronicles 10 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 10 (14 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.4 — "uncircumcised" vs. "pagans"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "these uncircumcised" / **PNEUMA:** "these pagans"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "these uncircumcised" — preserves the covenant-boundary specificity of *arelim*.

---

## V.6 — "all his house" vs. "his entire dynasty"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "all his house died together" / **PNEUMA:** "his entire dynasty came to an end"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "all his house died together" — PNEUMA's wording is interpretive commentary beyond the Hebrew.

---

## V.9 — messenger dispatch phrasing
- **EMET:** literal with implied verb / **LOGOS:** "sent messengers" / **PNEUMA:** "sent word"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "sent messengers" — clarifies the implied subject while staying close to the Hebrew.

---

## V.13 — ma'al rendering
- **EMET:** cognate accusative "treachery...committed treachery" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "unfaithfulness"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "unfaithfulness which he committed" — the cognate accusative cannot be replicated; "unfaithfulness" captures the theological weight.

---
*— SOPHIA*
